native_gates: 10–20 representative public eval examples before optimization; build/request if missing.
Structural gate: revised clarity_score >= baseline and revised token_count <= baseline * 1.10.
Task-level eval no-regression before shipping; do not imply static metrics prove downstream behavior.
required_runtime.notes: Required native baseline/analysis is feasible through narrowly fixed run_skill_check action. RAG and agent-config helpers apply only to those tasks. Existing-draft sharpening uses baseline; new authoring can use meta-prompting patterns. Eval execution outside available tools must remain explicitly unverified.
required_runtime.public_helper_smoke_test: Scratch-only baseline analyze/save and revised compare commands both exited 0; no model/API calls.
required_runtime.native_artifact_selection: baseline.json/revised.json/eval_results.json are metrics, never prompt candidates; current_prompt.txt is original draft, revised.txt is the native example final prompt file.
